name: npc_wokou-broker-01
customDialogue:
Everything has a price.
Even fear. Especially fear.

name: npc_wokou-dockhand-01
customDialogue:
The crane groans every time the ground shakes.
We tie everything down twice now.

name: npc_wokou-captain-01
customDialogue:
The sea is calm.
It is the ground under it that worries me.

name: npc_wokou-villager-01
customDialogue:
The Broker pays well for anything strange from the cracks.
Lately everything here is strange.

spotConfig.label: Open the crate
spotConfig.text: Inside the straw lies a shard of dark red stone, smooth as glass and warm as a hand. A ring of roots is carved on it: the same ring as on the Hub seal. It hums when the ground does.

spotConfig.label: Read the terms
spotConfig.text: WOKOU TERMS. One: a sea cave under the boat shed runs beneath the bay and comes up past every Samurai watch post. Two: the Hub may use it. Three: whatever comes up from below is sold by the Wokou first. Four: a Wokou seat at the Hub council.

spotConfig.label: Read the ledger
spotConfig.text: Rows of relics, prices and buyers. Three lines are marked in red: SHARD, WARM, HUMS. SHARD, WARM, HUMS. EYE IN A RING, DO NOT SELL.

spotConfig.label: Look at the relic
spotConfig.text: Tied to the crate stack: a sliver of red stone, still warm, with a thread of root grown through it.

spotConfig.label: Look at the relic
spotConfig.text: A carved disc, half stone, half root. It hums against your palm when the crane creaks.

spotConfig.label: Look at the relic
spotConfig.text: In a basket on the pier: a stone eye inside a ring of roots. The basket is labelled DO NOT SELL.

spotConfig.label: Knock and listen
spotConfig.text: You knock on a jar. A moment later, from far below, the knock comes back.

spotConfig.label: Knock and listen
spotConfig.text: The rope coils on this stall hum when the ground shakes. One jar at the back answers louder than the rest, but it is not here.
At the very end of the east beach, the ribs of an old ship stick out of the sand. The Wokou wave and dagger is burned into the keel.

spotConfig.label: Pick up the bottle
spotConfig.text: A green bottle in the wet sand. Inside, a note in a shaky hand: THE CAVE UNDER THE SHED GOES FURTHER THAN THEY SAY. DO NOT FOLLOW THE WARM AIR.
From the ridge the whole harbour lies below you: the quay, the piers, the ships, and far out, the islets where no Wokou boat will anchor.
The storm throws spray over the end of the pier. Between two waves the sea drains back and, for a moment, shows a dark opening in the quay wall.

spotConfig.label: Lift the loose plank
spotConfig.text: Under a loose plank at the foot of the old watchtower: a captain's ledger with the real prices. Every relic was sold three times over.

spotConfig.label: Look closer
spotConfig.text: A tiny ant peeks out at you.

hotspots.description: Every raid pays into this chest before anyone is paid. The captain keeps the key on a cord round the neck and sleeps in the bow beside it.
Rice, salt fish, fresh water and rope: forty days at sea if the wind is fair. Everything is lashed down twice; a loose crate in a storm can break a hull.

hotspots.description: Every red line is a voyage that came home. The Wokou trade where they can and raid where they must; the chart does not say which is which.
A merchant with false weights loses the right hand of trust. These scales are checked every new moon against the weights kept in the strongbox.
Turmeric, pepper, saffron, cinnamon and tea from islands most of the colony will never see. A sack of saffron is worth more than a house.
Four sea marks seal the strongbox behind the counter. The Broker says anyone who opens it without a key may keep the shine.

hotspots.description: The keel was laid at the last full moon. The ribs are cypress, bent in the steam box; when the planking is done she will slide down the slip into the bay.
Battened cloth, sewn by hand, the ant painted on it last. A Wokou sail is never thrown away: old ones become hammocks, then rags, then wicks.

hotspots.description: A deck in a storm never stays level. Cross the posts without touching the water, then cross them again carrying a blade, then blindfolded.
The first Wokou dojo was the deck of a ship. This window keeps the sea in sight, so no Wokou trains forgetting where the fight will be.

spotConfig.label: Check the vent marker
spotConfig.text: Steam pours from the old stone marker each time the thunder rolls, hot and tinged red. The ground under your feet hums with the sky.

spotConfig.label: Check the vent marker
spotConfig.text: The east marker is cracked through. When lightning strikes over the bay, a breath of warm air rises from the crack. Then the ground goes quiet again.

spotConfig.label: Check the vent marker
spotConfig.text: On the north road the marker has sunk a hand deep into the earth since the last storm. Red mud bubbles round its base.
